question: Should existing QA operators receive a compatibility/deprecation transition for retired Matrix `--profile` and suite `--pack` commands, or should the repository intentionally make those commands fail immediately with only the new taxonomy-profile and `--scenario` paths?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes operator-facing QA selectors and changes release workflow defaults; this is a product and upgrade-contract choice that source review cannot safely infer from a refactor alone.

options.title: Add explicit migration errors
options.body: Keep the taxonomy-owned planner, but reject retired selectors with concise replacement guidance and document the supported migration path.

options.title: Accept immediate retirement
options.body: Land the removal as an intentional source-checkout QA contract break and state the exact supported replacements in release and QA documentation.

options.title: Retain a temporary alias
options.body: Map retired selectors to named taxonomy profiles for one deprecation window, then remove them in a later planned change.

recommendation.title: Add explicit migration errors
recommendation.body: Keep the taxonomy-owned planner, but reject retired selectors with concise replacement guidance and document the supported migration path.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch and supplied discussion identify this contributor as the active owner of the QA selection architecture, although current-main ownership history still needs confirmation.
